tactics:
induction xs generalizing i with
| nil => simp
| cons a as ih =>
  intro h
  cases i with
  | zero => simp [List.findIdx_cons] at h ⊢; cases hp : p a <;> simp_all
  | succ j => simp [List.findIdx_cons] at h ⊢; cases hp : p a <;> simp_all
induction xs generalizing i <;> intro h <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.findIdx_cons] <;> split at h <;> simp_all
